messages.fm.author: Author / copyright holder
messages.fm.derivativesAllowed: Permission to create derivatives has been verified
messages.fm.rightsHelp: Credits do not replace permission. Record the actual author, source and license; approval is an operator decision, not a legal certification. Private evidence is excluded from public data. Uploaded images may retain EXIF/GPS/C2PA; use the explicit private-to-public derivative flow when licensed.
messages.fm.rightsChanged: Image bytes changed; review the rights again before approval.
messages.fm.selectMetadata: Select an image in Overview and choose Metadata, or edit an existing record below.
messages.fm.emptyRights: No rights records yet. Unknown authorship is not public domain.
messages.fm.publishCopyHelp: Creates a new public JPG/PNG/WebP through optional PHP GD, with technical metadata removed and rights kept in the catalog. The private original is preserved. Requires reviewed derivative permission; no animation/ICO/GIF conversion. Public images are not automatically rewritten.
messages.fm.error.rights: Invalid media rights or unavailable source. Check scope, permission and current revision.
